headline: Payment of invoices, including an AECOM invoice for the MCC/PC Replacement Project, and a capital projects update.
summary: The meeting will cover payment of invoices, capital projects, and the executive director's report. An AECOM invoice dated October 2, 2026 covers construction and resident engineering for the MCC/PC Replacement Project.
location: Max Goldstein Conference Room, 240 Charles St, North Andover, MA 01845-1649
